description.value: Fat Tuna is a sit-down Japanese sushi restaurant in Coquitlam recognized among the top 3 Japanese restaurants in the city by a third-party inspection. The menu features creative rolls alongside traditional sushi, and the restaurant accommodates food allergies. Online ordering is available via Toast for takeout.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, operating Japanese sushi restaurant with an address of 931 Brunette Ave, Coquitlam — not North Vancouver as the OSM community field suggests. The website provides a phone number and confirms online ordering via Toast, supporting a Takeout=true finding. No bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the website clearly places this business at 931 Brunette Ave, Coquitlam — the OSM record may be geolocated or community-tagged incorrectly.
URL discovery confidence was 'medium'; website domain (fattunasushi.online) differs slightly from the OSM name but content clearly matches the business.
OSM has no phone or address tags; both were sourced from the website only, so contact_confirmed fields cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Japanese restaurant with an active website and online ordering. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a meal.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website mentions a recent ownership change (referenced in customer reviews). Online ordering link has been updated to a new Toast URL as noted on the homepage.
